description: Deletes 1 to 25 items of one type: workouts, programs, exercises, exercise groups, drops, social automations, autopilot tasks or webhooks. Use when the user wants to remove content or automations from the team. Not for hiding content from members (use set_content_visibility). Returns which IDs were deleted and why any failed. Can't be undone.

ids.description: IDs of the items, 1 to 25. Get them from the list tool for the type, e.g. list_team_workouts or list_team_drops.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

type.description: What to delete: workout; program; exercise = a team exercise video; exercise_group = a circuit or sets group; drop = a social post; social_automation = a publishing automation; autopilot_task = a Content Autopilot task; webhook = a webhook endpoint.

name: delete_items
title: Delete items
